title: BOXBOX: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Long-Running Performance Optimization
title_zh: BOXBOX：面向长期性能优化的递归式执行框架自我改进

paragraphs.en: 提出BOXBOX框架支持智能体在长期任务中递归修订执行框架，在PerfRace基准上实现1.70倍加速并降低成本。 Automated harness optimization improves agents by learning from trajectories and task feedback. Existing offline methods use reference answers to optimize harnesses for reuse on held-out tasks. However, many real-world tasks are open-ended, while long runs expose new difficulties that offline-optimized harnesses may not address. To study harness optimization in these settings, we introduce PerfRace, a benchmark for long-running performance optimization of software projects, and investigate whether agents can use task-specific experience to recursively improve their harnesses during an ongoing task. To this end, we introduce BOXBOX, which enables agent-triggered harness revision and kernel-managed hot reloading while preserving execution context. We evaluate BOXBOX on PerfRace under matched test-time budgets, comparing it with Frozen Harness, offline Harness Evolution, and Harness Scaling. BOXBOX achieves higher speedup with more efficient use of task time and model cost, reaching a Speedup@4h of 1.70x, compared with 1.54x for the strongest baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 提出BOXBOX框架支持智能体在长期任务中递归修订执行框架，在PerfRace基准上实现1.70倍加速并降低成本。自动化的执行框架优化通过从轨迹和任务反馈中学习来改进智能体。 现有的离线方法使用参考答案来优化执行框架，以便在留出任务上复用。 然而，许多现实世界的任务是开放式的，而长时间运行会暴露出离线优化的执行框架可能无法解决的新困难。 为了研究这些场景下的执行框架优化，我们提出了PerfRace，一个面向软件项目长期运行性能优化的基准，并探究智能体能否在正在进行的任务中利用任务特定的经验递归地改进其执行框架。 为此，我们提出了BOXBOX，它在保留执行上下文的同时，支持由智能体触发的执行框架修订和内核管理的热重载。 我们在匹配的测试时预算下，在PerfRace上评估BOXBOX，并将其与Frozen Harness（冻结执行框架）、离线的Harness Evolution（执行框架演化）和Harness Scaling（执行框架扩展）进行比较。 BOXBOX以更高效的任务时间和模型成本利用实现了更高的加速，达到Speedup@4h为1.70倍，而最强基线为1.54倍。
